names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 31 ianuarie, «Sfântul Doctor fără de arginţi, făcătorul de minuni, Chir».

Read out of saint.gr's own heading for him on the page for 31 Ιανουαρίου, «Αγιος Κυρος ο Αναργυρος», with the rank words left off; the day's line keeps the seven of them together as «Άγιοι Κύρος και Ιωάννης οι Ανάργυροι και η Αγία Αθανασία με τις τρεις θυγατέρες της Θεοδότη, Θεοκτίστη και Ευδοξία».

death.note: The life gives the day and not the year: the beheading was «în 31 de zile ale lunii ianuarie», in the persecution the page dates by the reign, «Diocleţian (284-305)». The interval is that reign.

hymns.text: Sălăşluindu-se darul Treimii în inimile voastre cele curate, Preafericiţilor Chir şi Ioan, v-aţi arătat înfricoşători izgonitori ai duhurilor celor necurate; şi aţi fost tămăduitori ai neputinţelor, nu numai ai celor descoperite, ci şi ai celor ascunse. Drept aceea, îndrăzneală având către Dumnezeu Cel Iubitor de oameni, prin rugăciunile voastre, cele neîncetate, tămăduiţi patimile noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinţilor Mucenici doctori fără de arginţi Chir şi Ioan şi al celor împreună cu dânşii, Glasul 5

english.text: The grace of the Trinity taking up its dwelling in your pure hearts, most blessed Cyrus and John, ye were shown to be terrible drivers-out of unclean spirits, and ye healed infirmities, not the open ones only but the hidden as well. Wherefore, having boldness before God who loves mankind, heal our passions by your unceasing prayers.

hymns.text: Din Dumnezeiescul har primind, sfinţilor, dar de minuni, faceţi minuni neîncetat, tăind toate patimile noastre cu meşteşugul tămăduitor cel nevăzut, de Dumnezeu Înţelepţite Chir, cu Sfântul Ioan cel pururea mărit. Că voi sunteţi Dumnezeieşti doctori.

source.text: Doxologia — Condacul Sfinţilor Mucenici doctori fără de arginţi Chir şi Ioan şi al celor împreună cu dânşii, Glasul 3, «Fecioara astăzi...»

english.text: Having received from the divine grace, O saints, the gift of wonders, ye work wonders unceasingly, cutting away all our passions by the unseen healing art, O Cyrus made wise by God, with Saint John the ever-glorified. For ye are physicians of God.

hymns.text: Τά θαύματα τῶν Ἁγίων σου Μαρτύρων, τεῖχος ἀκαταμάχητον ἡμῖν δωρησάμενος, Χριστέ ὁ Θεός, ταῖς αὐτῶν ἱκεσίαις, βουλάς ἐθνῶν διασκέδασον, τῆς Βασιλείας τά σκῆπτρα κραταίωσον, ὡς μόνος ἀγαθός καί φιλάνθρωπος.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), Άγιοι Κύρος και Ιωάννης οι Ανάργυροι — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος πλ. α’. It is the common of martyrs, printed here under their names and naming neither of them.

english.text: Christ our God, who have given us the wonders of your holy martyrs as an unassailable wall: at their entreaties scatter the counsels of the nations and strengthen the sceptres of the kingdom, as the only good and lover of mankind.

hymns.text: Ὡς Ἀθλοφόροι εὐκλεεῖς τοῦ Σωτῆρος, καὶ ἰατῆρες τῶν ψυχῶν καὶ σωμάτων, Ἀνάργυροι ἐκλάμπετε ἐν πάσῃ τὴ γῆ, νόσων μὲν ἰώμενοι, ἀνωδύνως τὰ βάρη, χάριν δὲ πορίζαντες, τοὶς βοώαιν ἀπαύστως χαίρετε κρήναι θείων δωρεῶν, Κῦρε θεόφρον, καὶ Ἰωάννη ἔνδοξε.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), Άγιοι Κύρος και Ιωάννης οι Ανάργυροι — Ἕτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’. «Ὁ ὑψωθεὶς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ»

english.text: As the Saviour's glorious victors and healers of souls and bodies, unmercenary ones, you shine over the whole earth, curing the burdens of sickness without pain and providing grace to those who cry out unceasingly: rejoice, fountains of divine gifts, God-minded Cyrus and glorious John.

hymns.text: Ἐκ τῆς θείας χάριτος, τήν δωρεάν τῶν θαυμάτων, εἰληφότες Ἅγιοι, θαυματουργεῖτε ἀπαύστως, ἅπαντα ἡμῶν τά πάθη, τῇ χειρουργίᾳ, τέμνοντες, τῇ ἀοράτῳ, Κῦρε θεόφρον, σύν τῷ θείῳ Ἰωάννῃ· ὑμεῖς γάρ θείοι ἱατροί ὑπάρχετε.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), Άγιοι Κύρος και Ιωάννης οι Ανάργυροι — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος γ’. «Ἡ Παρθένος σήμερον»

english.text: Having received from divine grace the gift of wonders, holy ones, you work them unceasingly, cutting away all our passions by an unseen surgery, God-minded Cyrus with the divine John; for you are physicians given by God.
